dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale edges along the folded flight feathers, creating a series of parallel high-contrast lines against the dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary where the fine, relatively uniform texture of the crown meets the bold, large-scale mottled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Overall dorsal surface exhibits a striking scalloped or fish-scale visual texture caused by high-contrast white fringes on dark-based feathers.
